chunks: That Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام used to judge that for every joint of the fingers, there is one-third of the diyyah of that finger, except the thumb; for he used to judge that for each of its joints there is half of the diyyah of that thumb, because it has two joints.

key_terms.بِثُلُثِ عَقْلِ تِلْكَ الْأَصَابِعِ: one-third of the compensation assigned to that finger
key_terms.بِنِصْفِ عَقْلِ تِلْكَ الْإِبْهَامِ: half of the compensation assigned to the thumb

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for each joint of the fingers and the thumb in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on compensation for injuries to the joints of the fingers. It states that each finger joint carries one-third of that finger’s prescribed compensation, while the thumb is treated differently, with each of its two joints carrying half of its compensation.
